dedupe_keys.name: scales project thermal perception questionnaire data

description: IEA EBC Annex 69 collaborators publish the Scales Project questionnaire dataset to study how people interpret thermal-comfort scales. The public OSF description examines current thermal state, climatic background and adaptation in relation to thermal sensation, comfort and acceptance. The project contains final CSV and RData files dated April 2019, an Excel codebook, questionnaires, collection templates, submitted raw data and R scripts. It is free under CC0. Coverage is an international survey collection, not a continuous building-sensor record; numerical country and respondent totals were not independently stated on the inspected repository page. These responses can inform occupant-behaviour assumptions in building-energy simulations with model-energyplus and comparisons with data-ashrae-global-thermal-comfort-database-ii. A caveat is that reported scale interpretations depend on respondent context and questionnaire wording. The project was updated in April 2024, but that does not establish that every data file changed. No respondent records were downloaded.
